description: This PHP class represents an API request object within the OrangeHRM system. It encapsulates HTTP request data including request body, URL attributes, and query parameters, providing accessors and mutators for these components.

classes.name: Request
classes.description: Represents an HTTP API request, encapsulating the HTTP request object and parameter bags for body, attributes, and query parameters.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Request instance with a given HttpRequest object, extracting request data into ParameterBags.

methods.name: getBody
methods.description: Returns the ParameterBag containing request body parameters.

methods.name: setBody
methods.description: Sets the ParameterBag for request body parameters.

methods.name: getAttributes
methods.description: Returns the ParameterBag containing URL attributes.

methods.name: setAttributes
methods.description: Sets the ParameterBag for URL attributes.

methods.name: getQuery
methods.description: Returns the ParameterBag containing query string parameters.

methods.name: setQuery
methods.description: Sets the ParameterBag for query parameters.

methods.name: getAllParameters
methods.description: Merges and returns all request parameters from body, attributes, and query bags.
